quest.title: Tepetlisaurus Hide-and-Seek
quest.description: After running into a whole bunch of Tepetlisaurs while you're out on the road, you let your Saurian companion go off to play with them. But then it doesn't come back...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

chapter.title: In the Footsteps of the Chosen of Dragons

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, where is this mysterious place? So many little Tepetlisaurs...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could it be some sort of... Tepetlisaurus gathering spot?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! ...Rrrawr?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} looks so excited! Not often that you get to meet so many companions all in one go, huh?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh, you mean you wanna go over there and play with them? Come to think of it, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} hardly ever gets to hang out with other little Tepetlisaurs...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Uhh, Paimon's still a bit worried... Anyway, let's find somewhere to relax and have something to eat while we wait for {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: #You and Paimon find a nice spot nearby to rest until {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} is done playing.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: But you end up waiting longer than you expected...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon sure hopes nothing bad's happened...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Gotten a bit carried away with the fun and games, perhaps?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If so, we'll have to give him a good talking-to. The sun's nearly set!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh... Let's go track it down before it gets so dark we can't even see.

talks.objective: Go look for your missing Saurian companion

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hi! You haven't seen {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} around here, have you? Y'know, the new kid on the block...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's got a mark on its head and a scarf on its tail...

dialogues.speaker: Dopey Little Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: Rrrawr?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, seems like it can't understand what we're saying.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like we have no other choice but to go through them one by one...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Take a look at this little Tepetlisaurus... This one sure knows how to choose a spot for itself!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #No, that can't be {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} either. There's no tail-scarf.

dialogues.speaker: Tree-Climbing Little Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: Rrrawr?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, is there any chance you've seen...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: #Paimon tells the clever little Tepetlisaur what {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} looks like.

dialogues.speaker: Clever Little Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Clever Little Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: Rawr!!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wait a minute, does that mean you know we're looking for {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? You really are a clever little critter, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon, let's catch up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wow, so many Berries... Thanks! Wait a sec, we're looking for {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, not Berries!

dialogues.speaker: Clever Little Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: Rrrawr?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Well, being given Berries is never a bad thing, but it seems like {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} isn't here. Let's keep looking!

choices.text: We're not the type to say no to Berries!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, looks like we've got ourselves a little Tepetlisaurus digging about underground. This has to be—

dialogues.speaker: Little Tepetlisaurus Learning How to Dig
Paimon
dialogues.text: #Ugh, that's not {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} either...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #*sigh* How are there so many little Tepetlisaurs here? Where in Teyvat did {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} go?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello there, how do you do...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh, wait a sec... Why has Paimon suddenly started greeting little Tepetlisaurs like this?

dialogues.speaker: Lively Little Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: Rawr! Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why, Paimon, you're so polite!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, thanks...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #But back to the matter at hand, this little Tepetlisaur clearly isn't {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Well, let's just hope that {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s been having as much fun as this little one.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aha! So you've been here snoozing away! No wonder we couldn't find you all this time...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Wrroh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like you had so much fun you completely tired yourself out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But the world's a dangerous place, y'know! If you start feeling sleepy or need a rest, you've got to come find us first...

choices.text: I told you to be careful...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, alright... Nothing wrong with a bit of fun every now and again. But be more careful in the future, okay?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, why don't we go say hi to that big Tepetlisaurus over there? Who knows, we might get another chance to hang out with this lot someplace else in the future!

choices.text: I said not to be gone too long...

talks.objective: Say bye to the big Tepetlisaurus

dialogues.speaker: Big Parenty Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: Roarrr?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Thanks for taking care of {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} all this time!

dialogues.speaker: Big Parenty Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: Roarrr...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh, well... Whatever they just said, it went right over Paimon's head.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Anyway, it's about time we were off. Say goodbye, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't be sad, we'll see them again!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rowrr... Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Big Parenty Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: Roooar...

dialogues.speaker: Big Parenty Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: Raaarrr—

dialogues.speaker: Little Tepetlisaurs
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Little Tepetlisaurs
dialogues.text: Rawr, rrawr...

dialogues.speaker: Big Parenty Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: Rrroar...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The big Tepetlisaurus turns round, as if to signal that it was time that they were off...\nThe little Tepetlisaurs follow its lead, and together, they leave.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Aww, you're not feeling lonely are you, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, don't forget that we're here by your side!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rowrr, rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Dopey Little Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: Grainfruit, yummy...

dialogues.speaker: Dopey Little Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: *burp*

dialogues.speaker: Tree-Climbing Little Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: From stand here, all other Saurians small as bug...

dialogues.speaker: Clever Little Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: Let's eat, friend!

dialogues.speaker: Clever Little Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: Berry, Cacahuatl, Grainfruit!

dialogues.speaker: Little Tepetlisaurus Learning How to Dig
dialogues.text: Oh no, been caught... Must... Dig faster!

dialogues.speaker: Lively Little Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: Happy happy~ Me so happy~

dialogues.speaker: Big Parenty Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: Hehe, so much energy... Very good...

dialogues.speaker: Big Parenty Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: But... how many were there in total again...?
